headline:
Homes Took A Bit Longer
To Sell In September
titan_line: Echo, Realtor.com says the median home in Henry County sat on the market 63 days in September, up from 59 in August. New listings were 390.
checks_rows: Last September the median was 68 days
Counts single-family homes, condos and townhomes
echo_line: Median? …Oh, the middle one. So a little slower than August, but quicker than last year.
source: Realtor.com via FRED · Henry County, GA median days on market and new listings · retrieved Oct 9, 2026
disclaimer: County-wide figures for the month stated. Not a valuation or a prediction for any individual home.
